output.question: What is Rivian's short interest?
output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, Rivian Automotive (NASDAQ: RIVN)'s latest reported short interest was 173,589,615 shares, for the October 30, 2026 settlement date. ChartExchange reports this as 18.41% of float, with 5.88 days to cover. Shares short increased 5.78% from the October 15 report. These are delayed reported positions, not a live measure of today's short interest.

key_facts.fact: As of October 30, 2026, RIVN had 173,589,615 shares sold short, the latest reported settlement available on the opened pages.
For October 30, 2026, ChartExchange reports short interest of 18.41% of float and 5.88 days to cover.
Short positions increased by 9,479,017 shares, or 5.78%, from October 15 to October 30, 2026.

passages.quote: As of 2026-10-30, there were 173,589,615 shares short with a short interest of 18.41%.
Days to cover was 5.88 based on FINRA's reported average daily volume.

caveats: The position date is October 30, 2026, not November 11, 2026; reported short interest is not real-time.
Float percentages differ across providers: the FINVIZ page opened on November 11, 2026 showed 18.26%, versus ChartExchange's 18.41%. Source: https://finviz.com/stock?p=d&t=RIVN,PTON&ta=1&ty=si
The figures were verified through third-party pages attributing the reported positions to FINRA, not directly against a FINRA data file.
